title: Reports
subtitle: Generate ready-made reports with unit, period and date filters and download them as Excel. Your recent reports are listed below.

catalog.title: Report types
catalog.empty: There are no ready-made reports you can access.
catalog.selectHint: Pick a report type; its filters open alongside.

missingDocuments.label: Missing documents report
missingDocuments.description: Required document status per employee (missing, uploaded, waived) with due dates.

list.label: Employee list report
list.description: Headcount list: career placement, hire date, employment status, contact details and employment type.

departed.label: Departed employee information
departed.description: Employees who left in the selected year (default: current year): career placement, hire/termination date, tenure and manager.

birthdays.label: Birthday list
birthdays.description: Employees with a birthday in the selected month (default: current month), ordered by day.

turnover.label: Employee turnover report
turnover.description: Turnover rate summary for the selected year (default: current year) plus a breakdown of departed employees.

summary.label: Employee leave balance report
summary.description: Annual leave balances as of today: remaining, total entitled, carry-over losses, used and future approved leave.

requests.label: Leave report
requests.description: Leave requests in the selected date range: type, duration, status, request and decision dates.

monthly.label: Monthly overtime report
monthly.description: Approved overtime requests for the selected month: duration, pay rate and, where applicable, conversion to leave or payment.

form.label: Leave reconciliation form
form.description: Summary of the approved leave each employee used in the selected period, printable with blank columns for the employee's signature and HR approval.

company_ledger.label: Company-wide leave/overtime ledger
company_ledger.description: Excel export of the company-wide view next to "My Leave"/"My Overtime": who is on leave in the selected month, annual leave balance and annual overtime (270-hour limit).

monthly_usage.label: Leave usage report
monthly_usage.description: Leave used (approved) in the selected month (default: current month): type, start, end and day count.

salaries.label: Salary list report
salaries.description: Salary records in effect today: amount, currency, net/gross, pay frequency and transport/meal allowances.

summary.label: Monthly timesheet summary report
summary.description: Per employee for the selected month: recorded/worked days, worked, overtime and night hours; late arrival, early leave, missing day, worked-while-on-leave and unresolved anomaly counts.

closing.label: Month-end closing (accountant) report
closing.description: The monthly timesheet summary plus paid, unpaid and sick leave days, whether the month is approved and the approval date.

overview.label: Overview report
overview.description: Applications per job posting broken down by pipeline stage: new application, screening, interview, offer, hired, rejected and total. Optional application date range.

daily_counts.label: Daily counts report
daily_counts.description: New applications and newly added candidates for every day in the selected date range (days with none appear as zero).

candidates_export.label: Candidate list export
candidates_export.description: Candidates: contact details, source, tags and the postings applied to with their current stage. Optional created-date range.

run.title: Generate report
run.error: The report could not be generated.
run.noFilters: This report takes no filters; you can generate it right away.

params.orgUnitIdsHint: Selected units and their sub-units are included.

history.title: Recent reports
history.downloadError: The report file could not be downloaded.
history.empty: No reports have been generated yet.
history.fromEmail: The report from your e-mail is ready; the download has started.

kpis.title: HR indicators
kpis.subtitle: Computed live from current employee data. The period filter affects turnover and career ratios; distributions show today's headcount.
kpis.empty: No indicator data for the selected period.
kpis.scopedNote: Your permission is unit-scoped, so only the per-unit and per-department distribution is shown.

cards.earlyTurnoverHint: Terminations in period with tenure under 6 months
cards.careerPathHint: Promotions, lateral moves and title changes in period / active headcount

charts.suppressedCount: {{count}} breakdown row(s) hidden for having fewer than 5 people - see the breakdown table for detail
